description: By the 1980s, the old José María Root group is trying to build adult lives rather than merely imagine them. Camilo's first novel and Eva's growing career expose class, money and ambition problems in their relationship; Salcedo's addiction, Pabón's love life and the AIDS crisis reshape the group around them. A three-year separation, Eva's return and a film project bring the friends together again, until political violence involving M-19 forces them to confront how far Colombia and their own lives have changed.

s04e01.description: After debuting his first novel, Camilo is shaken when his friends turn against him. Luisa and Arbeláez's decision opens the door to 364.

s04e02.description: Eva's visit to the Dominican Republic's embassy is unexpectedly interrupted. Camilo and the group mobilize to stop a tragedy from occurring.

s04e03.description: Eva and Camilo take a big step in their relationship. Vandalia's activities threaten the group's safety. Rosario tries to start a school for Janet.

s04e04.description: A move highlights the differences between Eva and Camilo's lives. Arbeláez defends Janet, and a visitor throws a wrench in Ana and José's relationship.

s04e05.description: Money troubles push Camilo and Eva over the edge. Janet makes a proposal to Rosario and José regarding her future. Lucy joins the tenants of 364.

s04e06.description: A trip to Cauca for a special ceremony yields breakthroughs for Eva and Pabón. José helps Camilo find a legendary wrestler.

s04e07.description: Eva's new job has unforeseen challenges. A series of massive life changes put Camilo and Eva under intense pressure. A familiar face returns.

s04e08.description: Eva pursues a new career. A chat with Estela inspires Lucy to step out of her comfort zone. A critique of Camilo's novel leads him to new pursuits.

s04e09.description: Eva's and Camilo's careers take off, as Pabón falls in love. A talk with Castro leaves Salcedo suspicious as relationships implode.

s04e10.description: Salcedo's addiction catches up to him, and an invitation from José changes his life. The AIDS epidemic shakes Pabón. Eva's work trip unbalances Camilo.

s04e11.description: Three years later, Eva returns to Colombia — but she isn't alone. Camilo lashes out. Janet makes a new friend, much to José's consternation.

s04e12.description: The group makes a movie, but an M-19 incident changes the course of their lives. Oswald throws José a curveball, and Ana's proposal takes off.
